reason: B is better grounded because it cites prior work on the exact AlCoCrFeNi–WC laser-cladding system and directly tests repair performance against fusion-welded and untreated controls. Its unsupported 30–60% hardness estimate and claim that rapid solidification reduces residual stress should be revised, but A has the more serious issues of calling four-component CoCrFeNi an HEA and asserting without support that WC limits thermal gradients.
